The only thing I can really say about F4 is that I got bored with it.

And that's a really, really dangerous thing to say about an open-world sandbox game. Every single quest was solved by shooting things. I found a grand total of 1 quest that had any kind of skill check - so the entire SPECIAL system (which is a fantastic base system, IMO) got turned into "choose how you wanna do damage". The weapon customization was kinda cool to start but there was never any reason to use a mod that did anything other than more damage.

Literally the only interesting thing I found in the game was customizable power armor. But the amount of grinding and materials necessary to get a tricked out set was absurd compared to the relative difficulty of the game.

And while the Legendary weapon system was again, neat in concept, the Legendary enemies is the laziest way of adding artificial difficulty I've ever seen in a game. Have a sneaky sniper character? Better hope you kill him in one hit or else he goes back to full HP and all of his friends magically know where you are. Never mind the "Legendary Protectron has mutated!", dear god who thought it would be a good idea for it to work that way?

The only really good thing about F4 is that it makes me want to play New Vegas, which is always worth playing.
